notes.title: Shroomtopia Update - Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone[/h3]

Following our roadmap, we have implemented several improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812618/292627d18fa472f81ec29f24977c0aca72fd54ea.gif[/img].

[h2]Shroomtopia Update – Patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Level selector.
[*] Automatic advancement when completing a level.
[*] Level number indicator.
[*] New navigation button icons.
[*] Updated character appearance.
[*] Progress saved on Steam Cloud.
[*] Various visual effects.
[/list]

We continue working on a [b]new portal mechanic[/b]. We're excited to see how cool this can be for players.

As soon as possible we will have a new version of the demo available in the store with these and other improvements.

notes.title: Shroomtopia Demo Update - Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Thank you all for the valuable feedback! Your input has been applied to this new version of the demo.

[h2]Demo Update – Patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Level 8 and 13 slightly changed.
[*] Character artist "Kelvin Costa" added to credits.
[*] Navigation buttons more noticeable.
[*] Navigation button highlight fixed.
[*] Fertilizing soil now properly goes back to random colors after an undo action.
[/list]

notes.title: Shroomtopia Demo Update - Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We would like to announce that the first [b]update[/b] to the [b]Shroomtopia Demo[/b] is now [b]live[/b], with many improvements and refinements based on your [b]feedback[/b]. Thank you all very much for contributing to the [b]creation[/b] of this game!

[h2]Demo Update – Patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lots of performance inprovements!
[*] Added a subtle glow to the fertilizing soil.
[*] Added subtle highlights to some UI buttons.
[*] Added buttons to go back instead of having to press ESC every screen.
[*] Levels 8, 12 and 15 adjusted.
[*] Small visual bug fixes.
[/list]
